title: Roveia sideways service track (v2)
description: A 32px label over a row of pale grey 500px service cards (illustration slot, 32px title, small translucent chips, a one-line promise). On desktop the section pins and the row slides left with the scroll; the card passing the middle takes a soft blue tint and its picture turns from grey to colour. On phones the cards stack and rise in.
notes: desktop (≥1024px): a window-tall stage (h-svh) pinned inside a 380svh wrapper; CSS scroll-driven, no JavaScript
the media slot takes an illustration (object-fit: contain); empty it is a faint tile
name: roveia-v2-services
